research_question: How are the occurrences of the crown-of-thorns seastar (CoTS) genus distributed globally according to OBIS records?

phase_1.user_prompt: I'm looking into the spatial distribution of crown-of-thorns seastars (CoTS) globally to understand the biogeography of the species complex.
